Question / Problem Statement: A triangular roof truss has rafter slopes of 30° on the South side and 45° on the North side. If the South rafter is 8.5 meters long, calculate the span of the building and the length of the North rafter.
Final Answer: North rafter = 4.25√2 ≈ 6.01 m; Building span ≈ 11.61 m
Step-by-Step Solution: Apex angle = 180° - 75° = 105°. By Law of Sines: North rafter = 8.5 * sin(30°) / sin(45°) = 4.25√2 ≈ 6.01 m. Span = 8.5 * sin(105°) / sin(45°) ≈ 11.61 m.

Question / Problem Statement: A searchlight sweeps across a lake, tracking a boat at point A with angle 35° and a boat at point B with angle 52°. If the distance between the boats is 180 m, find the distance from the searchlight to boat A.
Final Answer: SA ≈ 485.14 m (sweep angle 17°); or 142.04 m (interior angles)
Step-by-Step Solution: With tracking sweep ∠S = 52° - 35° = 17° and angle at boat B = 180° - 52° = 128°: SA = 180 * sin(52°) / sin(17°) ≈ 485.14 m. (If 35° and 52° are interior angles, apex is 93°, yielding SA = 180 * sin(52°) / sin(93°) ≈ 142.04 m).
